## Live finding — F-R6H11-1 (restore apply does not converge the live collab doc)

Observed 2026-10-27 on prod `e04a8c8`, project `01M5XT6D4HFYR5BXPDBW8NKQQM`
(draft v2 `01M5XT6D4HY039HWGWS25FRF5Z`, live doc `01M5XT6J6NNP675ND4J8JX2SKW`):

1. Named restore point minted via ⌘S **pre-edit** (`restore_points
   01M5XT6JCH11BEB32Q3732G7WD`, cause=named), then a typed marker
   `h11rail-q6xzrg` synced; materialize wrote `artifact_versions` ord2
   (`3619d1…`, marker present).
2. `?restore=<named>` preview + apply → 302 `?restored=2` +
   `data-restored-notice`; the apply wrote ord3 (`8610410…`) = the pre-edit
   text (verified bytes: `gsutil cat …/objects/8610410…` contains no marker),
   minted the "Before restore" undo point, and issued the wholesale
   `live_docs.y_state` replace.
3. **Divergence:** the same session's canvas still rendered the marker, and a
   *fresh* browser context (clean IndexedDB, same cookies — the storageState
   cache carries no idb) still renders it. `live_docs.y_state` (10193 bytes)
   contains the marker as live items; `live_docs.md_sha256` = the restored
   ord3 sha. A subsequent collab flush overwrote the apply's `y_state` write —
   the running collab runtime never reloaded, so its in-memory Y.Doc kept the
   pre-restore items and re-merged them into the persisted state.

Impact: a restore "apply" is correct in stored markdown but not in the live
collab doc — any editor reconnect resurrects the restored-away text, and the
next materialize can persist it back (silently un-applying the restore).
Likely fix shape: the restore route must evict/rebind the collab runtime
(close connections + afterUnloadDocument, or bump the document identity) so
stale y-histories cannot merge — not just rewrite `y_state`. Filed as OPEN in
the LEDGER; this run does not attempt the fix (cross-service design change,
not a narrow scope).

## Live finding — F-R6H11-2 (deployed run-task image cannot execute runs)

Observed 2026-10-27 on prod `e04a8c8`, run `01M5XTD893J1F5SKMXCHSS32VH`
(`jrn-586d9c8d0ba7-r6excerpt`, Quick/Base review on jrn-a):

1. `steps(intake, attempt 3, state=failed, ~1 s)` with
   `result.reason`: *"run-task: the vendored @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk is
   not present in this image — it must be vendored at build time (see
   apps/run-task/Dockerfile). Refusing to run without an engine."*
   (`result.errorClass: infra`).
2. `deployments` shows `run-task sha256:c7cf69c6…` for `e04a8c8`
   (deployed 2026-10-26T15:25Z). Every intake attempt since fails identically;
   the reaper's 2× re-enqueue → `resume_partial` path fired exactly as designed
   (the backstop works; the payload never could).
3. Blast radius: **no run can complete on prod** — the 2026-10-26 "completed"
   showcase run was fixture-seeded (7 steps stamped at identical timestamps,
   zero usage rows); zero non-`req_jrn_` `usage_records(source='proxy')` rows
   exist since ≥2026-10-23 except this run's 12 preflight calls.
4. Resolution: rebuild/redeploy the `run-task` image with the vendored SDK
   (`apps/run-task/Dockerfile`), then re-drive a paid leg to prove the meter
   path end-to-end. Filed OPEN in the LEDGER; out of this run's scope (image
   build/deploy is operator-owned).

**B11 caveat:** the EventSource/live-feed leg itself is fully discharged
(transport, feed append, cursor resume `?after=2→22`, zero document loads,
plus the terminal `cancelled` card arriving post-decision on the same live
document). The in-phase *meter advancement* could not be exercised — intake
never metered — so "meter ticks upward mid-phase" remains owed inside
D-PRB.04-2 until a working image exists. Recorded, not faked.
